subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'to eat'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the blank is working as the director for the verb 'had'.
 
• **Infinitive:** the basic form of a verb that usually follows "to" and can be used as a **direct object, adjective, adverb, bare and full infinitive.**
 
• Thus, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is 'to eat'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence:__ My wife was very ill, and we had no food **(3) to eat.**
